description: Catalog of NATIVE CRM Task columns the automation engine may read / watch / set — the Task resource's field brain for its OWN columns. Its per-task-type DECLARED fields live on CRM Task Type Field; this holds the native columns (status, ...). Completes 'one brain per resource' for Task: Lead's native columns live on CRM Lead API Field; Task's live here. Grain for a native Task column derives from the task's type (the contract), never stored on these rows.

fields.label: Fieldname
fields.description: The native column on CRM Task (e.g. status).

fields.label: Automation: Readable
fields.description: A workflow criterion may test this Task column.

fields.label: Automation: Watchable
fields.description: A change to this Task column may fire a workflow (changed-to). Implies Readable — the dispatcher captures its before-value so a rule fires only on the transition.

fields.label: Automation: Settable
fields.description: A workflow action may write this Task column.

name: CRM Task Field
